tools.name: check_solana_token_basic
tools.description: Free: verdict, token facts, shell check and holder summary for a Solana mint if it was scanned in the last hour. Returns status=not_cached otherwise. No key needed.

tools.name: check_solana_token_lite
tools.description: Lite read (bagcheck.lite.v1): verdict, top-10 holder %, dev stake, launch buy / dev sold, KOL wallets holding, basic flags. Free for 3 fresh reads per day, then 1 credit; cached reads are free. Requires an API key. Not financial advice.

tools.name: analyze_solana_token
tools.description: Full Bag Check (bagcheck.v1): verdict with reasons, shell/rug checks, top-holder behaviour (never sold / sold / churn / fresh), bundles, callers. 1 credit for a fresh scan, 0 if a scan newer than max_data_age_seconds exists. Requires an API key. Not financial advice.

tools.name: watch_report
tools.description: Current Bag Watch snapshot and recent alerts (bagwatch.report.v1) for a coin on your Watch list. Requires a key for a wallet with an active Watch plan. Free.

tools.name: alerts_since
tools.description: Alerts (bagwatch.alert.v1) across your watched coins and wallets, oldest first, after the given cursor. Pass next_cursor back to page. Requires a Watch plan key. Free.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: Credits left in your 30-day cycle (pool_resets_at = next refill) for your key, where they come from (free / Watch / Roach tier), and the per-key daily cap. Free.

tools.name: get_credit_packs
tools.description: Free, no key: credit pack prices (100 credits for 0.05 SOL, 5 USDC, or $STILL at 20% off; Solana only, no cards) and the keyless x402 pay-per-call option (USDC on Solana: lite 0.02, full 0.08 fresh / 0.02 cached, AI +0.04). Read-only: never moves funds. Ask the user before any payment.
